How are the rankings calculated? +

Each weekly test carries 100 points, for a maximum of 500 across five weeks. Rankings use cumulative scores. Final ties follow the committee’s pre-announced criteria. Demo ties are shown with equal ranks.

Which category and track should I follow? +

First-year students compete in Junior. Second-, third-, and fourth-year students compete in Senior and choose either Core or Computer Science. Senior tracks cannot be changed after registration.

What can participants earn? +

The ₹7,000 prize pool is divided equally between Junior and Senior category Champions, alongside merit certificates and trophies. All participants receive participation certificates. Weekly highlights recognise top performers and the biggest climber; Perfect Five recognises attendance across all five weeks.

Where do I get official updates? +

Follow the Silicon Achievers’ Club’s official channels for schedules, answer keys, recovery rules, and results. For queries: Deepa Kumari +91 9310376071 or Rudrakshi Birna +91 8249683361.
